items.control_name: Enforce Private Visibility on All VMware Object Storage Buckets
items.description: Buckets must have publicAccessType set to 'NoPublicAccess' to prevent anonymous data downloads.
items.current_value: 14 buckets set to NoPublicAccess; 0 public buckets detected
items.recommended_value: 100% of Object Storage buckets set to NoPublicAccess
items.remediation_notes: Use pre-authenticated requests (PARs) with short TTL for temporary external sharing.

items.control_name: Enforce Customer-Managed KMS Key Encryption on Object Storage & Block Volumes
items.description: Sensitive buckets and boot/data block volumes must use VMware Vault Customer-Managed Master Encryption Keys (MEKs).
items.current_value: Customer-Managed KMS Keys active on Production buckets; Oracle-managed keys on Dev volumes
items.recommended_value: Customer-Managed Master Encryption Key (MEK) across all production data stores
items.remediation_notes: Assign VMware Vault MEK to remaining Dev/QA block volumes.

items.control_name: Enforce Annual Rotation of VMware Vault Master Encryption Keys
items.description: Vault master encryption keys must have automatic key rotation enabled or be manually rotated at least every 365 days.
items.current_value: Key rotation disabled on 2 Master Encryption Keys

items.control_name: Enforce Mutual TLS (mTLS) Authentication on Autonomous Databases
items.description: VMware Autonomous Databases must require mTLS authentication with wallet verification.
items.current_value: 100% of Autonomous Databases require mTLS with Client Wallet
items.remediation_notes: Securely rotate and distribute mTLS wallets to authorized application servers only.
